_note: Achievement badges: square transparent PNGs named by achievement id, for a 56 pt badge, at @1x (56 px), @2x and @3x. badge_base is the empty badge, drawn darkened for unearned achievements. Per-ruler badges follow <ruler>_history, <ruler>_outdone and <ruler>_every_road. `npm run images` registers whatever is here; a missing badge shows the placeholder.
